name: Elbridge Colby
current_role: Under Secretary of War (Defense) for Policy (since April 2025)
summary: Elbridge Colby, the Pentagon’s top policy official, was confirmed 54–45 on April 8, 2025. A defense strategist who argues the U.S. should prioritize deterring China, he helped write the 2018 National Defense Strategy as a deputy assistant secretary in Trump’s first term.
